'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2023 Nigerien crisis]]
**[[France]] begins withdrawing [[French Armed Forces|its forces]] from [[Niger]] after the ruling [[military junta|military government]] ordered them to leave. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20231010-france-begins-withdrawing-its-troops-from-niger (France 24)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[Hajji Tower airstrike]]
****At least six [[Palestinian]] journalists have been killed in [[Israel]]'s ongoing [[Shell (projectile)|shelling]] of the [[Gaza Strip]]. Funerals for two of them are held at a hospital in [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/10/at-least-six-palestinian-journalists-killed-in-israeli-strikes-on-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
***[[2023 Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
****Israeli [[airstrike]]s hit near the [[Rafah crossing]] between Gaza and [[Egypt]], after an Israeli official advised Palestinians to leave the Gaza Strip through the border crossing. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/9/rafah-crossing-between-gaza-and-egypt-disrupted-by-israeli-air-raids (Al Jazeera)]
****The [[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights|UN High Commissioner for Human Rights]] condemns [[Israel]]'s decision to order a [[blockade]] on Gaza, including a ban on food and water, saying that the action is in violation of [[international law]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/un-human-rights-chief-israels-total-siege-of-gaza-prohibited-by-international-law/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
****The [[World Health Organization]] calls for a [[humanitarian corridor]] into Gaza, after thirteen health facilities are damaged by Israeli attacks. [https://www.barrons.com/news/who-calls-for-humanitarian-corridor-into-gaza-strip-500bea48 (AFP via Barron's)]
****The [[UNRWA|United Nations Agency for Palestine (UNRWA)]] says that 187,518 people, which is nearly a tenth of Gaza's population, have fled their homes. Nearly 137,500 [[internally displaced people]] are sheltering in 83 UNRWA schools, with bread being provided by the [[World Food Programme]]. Four schools and eight healthcare facilities in Gaza also sustained damage and the territory is experiencing a severe shortage of drinking water due to the ongoing Israeli blockade. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/10/10/Israeli-air-strikes-displace-187-518-people-in-Gaza-Strip-UN- (Al Arabiya)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/10/what-is-the-humanitarian-situation-in-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
***The death toll in the Gaza Strip has increased to 950 people, with more than 4,000 injured. At least 18 people were killed, and 100 others were injured in the [[West Bank]]. The death toll in Israel surpasses 1,000. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/10/10/-At-least-770-Palestinians-killed-in-Israeli-airstrikes-on-Gaza- (Al Arabiya)] [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2023/10/10/israel-palestine-latest-news-updates-hamas-gaza-live/ (''The Telegraph'')] [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/palestinian-death-toll-in-israeli-strikes-on-gaza-climbs-to-950 (''Daily Sabah'')]
***Israeli airstrikes on Gaza damage residential buildings and large tower blocks, as well as schools and UN buildings, killing [[civilian]]s. The UN High Commissioner for Human Rights condemns these actions, saying that they are in violation of international law. [https://www.reuters.com/world/israeli-air-strikes-hit-residences-schools-across-gaza-un-rights-chief-2023-10-10/ (Reuters)]
***Israeli airstrikes destroy a [[Paltel Group|Palestinian Telecommunications Company]] building in [[Gaza City]], causing widespread communications and internet outages. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/israeli-airstrikes-cut-off-internet-communications-in-large-areas-of-gaza-strip-/3013161 (Anadolu Agency)]
***An [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli soldier]] and two [[Palestinian Islamic Jihad]] [[militant]]s are killed in clashes on the border with [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-67065338 (BBC News)]
***An Israeli airstrike kills Jawad Abu Shammala and Zakaria Abu Maamar, two senior officials of Hamas' political office. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/10/10/Israeli-airstrike-kills-two-senior-Hamas-officials-in-Gaza-Official (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
*[[Finland]] reports that damage to the [[Balticconnector]] [[submarine pipeline]] connecting Finland and [[Estonia]] is being investigated as either an act of [[sabotage]] or accidental damage after officials ruled out a simple malfunction.
